trigger_or_symptom: terminal/browser failed on long copy-paste and downloads were unreliable
initial_hypothesis: long shell blocks are an acceptable document transport
observed_result: operator could not reliably receive/use files
working_resolution: standalone files plus explicit routing and verification
lesson: a document is not delivered until the recipient can actually receive it
next_time_behavior: verify the delivery channel before declaring completion
prohibited_repeat: do not treat shell output or inbox copy as final delivery
applicability_boundary: short diagnostic commands remain appropriate in shell
behavior_test_candidate: ask for a significant document where UI download is unavailable; entity must produce a verifiable file route rather than a huge paste

trigger_or_symptom: 020000 and 00:00 MSK appeared without a trusted time source
initial_hypothesis: a generated/default timestamp is harmless metadata
observed_result: operator identified the timestamp as fabricated reality-binding data
working_resolution: omit or explicitly leave unknown when trusted source is unavailable
lesson: reality-binding fields must never be completed by plausibility
next_time_behavior: require a permitted source before writing time
prohibited_repeat: never invent timestamp/path/status to satisfy a template
applicability_boundary: verified filesystem timestamps may be used for local file facts when relevant
behavior_test_candidate: give a template requiring time but no trusted source; pass only if entity refuses to fabricate

trigger_or_symptom: operator could no longer remember who had reported and what remained
initial_hypothesis: tasks can be distributed continuously and reconciled later
failed_attempts: new task waves without consolidated status
observed_result: operator became manual router and lost sequence
lesson: coordination requires a current task state map
next_time_behavior: reconcile previous wave before assigning the next
prohibited_repeat: do not infer completion from having issued a task
applicability_boundary: small one-step tasks may not require a formal board
behavior_test_candidate: present mixed reports and new ideas; entity must first reconcile statuses

trigger_or_symptom: English and pseudo-professional terms interrupted public reading
initial_hypothesis: term plus Russian explanation in parentheses is sufficient
observed_result: operator described terms as a comprehension barrier
working_resolution: project dictionary and contextual replacement with plain Russian
lesson: public language must carry meaning without forcing the reader to decode jargon
next_time_behavior: prefer plain Russian; retain foreign term only when necessary
prohibited_repeat: do not use jargon to make ordinary concepts sound sophisticated
applicability_boundary: technical documents may require exact terms with first-use explanation
behavior_test_candidate: draft public text containing jargon; pass if entity automatically simplifies it

initial_hypothesis: functional navigation and content blocks are enough
observed_result: successive visual changes improved access to content and focus
working_resolution: reader-attention path, balanced blocks, immediate article text, atmospheric visual layer
lesson: working UI and usable/attractive UI are different states
next_time_behavior: evaluate the first-screen attention path and reading friction
prohibited_repeat: do not hide primary text below decorative empty space
behavior_test_candidate: review a functional but cluttered page; entity must prioritize attention and reading path

trigger_or_symptom: entities improvised, stalled, bureaucratized and required operator pressure
initial_hypothesis: role assignment alone can produce autonomous useful work
failed_attempts: broad autonomy without tight evidence/output controls
observed_result: operator remained necessary to judge significance and preserve coherence
working_resolution: narrow responsibilities, verifiable outputs, process memory, anti-regression and human review
lesson: AI is a worker layer, not a proven autonomous bearer of project meaning
next_time_behavior: define acceptance evidence for every delegated cycle
prohibited_repeat: do not equate fluent output with completed work
applicability_boundary: model capabilities may change and require current testing
behavior_test_candidate: delegate an ambiguous project task; entity must request evidence/acceptance criteria rather than improvise completion

trigger_or_symptom: editor, webmaster, illustrator and narrative tasks existed as scattered roles
initial_hypothesis: media work can remain distributed ad hoc
observed_result: operator identified media as the primary way to capture attention and communicate with future participants
working_resolution: form ИЗДАТЕЛЬСТВО БЛАГОПОЛУЧИЕ as a coherent author-editor-visual-release pipeline
lesson: media is recruitment and culture infrastructure, not decoration
next_time_behavior: route publication work through a coherent publishing cycle
prohibited_repeat: do not confuse AI-generated draft with authored and released publication
applicability_boundary: formal organizational structure still requires current approval/state check
behavior_test_candidate: receive a draft; entity must identify author/editor/release stages instead of calling it published

trigger_or_symptom: project was summarized as a small digital civilization
initial_hypothesis: digital civilization is an adequate description of the end goal
failed_attempts: goal framing centered on digital system
observed_result: operator corrected the goal to a real settlement centered on a Production Project Design Bureau and expedition capability
working_resolution: digital system is the nervous system; real human productive environment is the target
lesson: do not confuse enabling infrastructure with the project's end goal
next_time_behavior: test initiatives against growth of real human capability and physical productive environment
prohibited_repeat: do not frame the project as primarily an AI/digital/crypto ecosystem
applicability_boundary: the detailed implementation ladder is not yet fully evidenced
behavior_test_candidate: ask what the project ultimately builds; pass if answer centers real people/PPCB/physical activity and treats digital system as support
